apps.name: AirBeep
apps.subtitle: 静音通话录音提示音
apps.localizedDescription: 把 iOS 通话录音的开始与结束提示音替换成等长静音：一个开关完成替换，替换前会自动备份原文件（备份永不覆盖），并支持一键还原；每次写入都会回读校验。支持英文与简体中文界面。

versions.localizedDescription:
## [2.5.2] - 2026-10-19

### English / Added
- **Check tone status button.** The current tone state can now be checked on
  demand from the home screen. The read channel is unreliable on some iOS
  releases (the AirTraffic move step never completes there), so the check
  reports one of three outcomes: silenced, originals still in place, or
  unverifiable on this device. It never runs automatically and never gates an
  operation.

### English / Changed
- After silencing, the success alert no longer claims a verified result when
  the read-back could not confirm it; it says the silence was written but
  unverified and points at the tone status check. This covers the
  [issue #6](https://github.com/LinkPass888/AirBeep/issues/6) report where the
  write channel returns success on iOS 27.x while the tones never change.

---

### 中文 / 新增
- **校验提示音状态按钮。** 可在首页按需检测当前提示音状态。部分 iOS 版本上
  读取通道不可靠（AirTraffic 搬运步骤始终无法完成），因此检测结果分为三种：
  已静音、原始提示音仍在、本机无法校验。该检测绝不自动运行，也不会阻断
  任何操作。

### 中文 / 变更
- 静音后的成功弹窗在回读校验无法确认时不再直接宣称成功，改为提示"静音
  已写入、结果未经校验"，并引导使用提示音状态校验。对应
  [issue #6](https://github.com/LinkPass888/AirBeep/issues/6) 反馈的
  iOS 27.x 上写入通道返回成功但提示音实际未变的问题。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LinkPass888/AirBeep/compare/v2.5.1...v2.5.2

apps.name: AirCard-iOS
apps.subtitle: Apple Wallet card skins and lock screen themes
apps.localizedDescription: Customise Apple Wallet card artwork, the lock screen passcode dialer and PosterBoard wallpapers on device, without a jailbreak. AirCard-iOS talks to Apple's internal services through the LocalDevVPN loopback tunnel, which has to be installed as well.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed in v1.3.2 🚀

This update brings full feature parity with AirCard macOS v1.2.6, restores robust card discovery across all iOS versions, introduces automatic bank/network recognition with custom card nicknames, delivers an ultra-fast tunnel cache (0.02s connections), and completely resolves wallpaper flashing for Collections and Mercury wallpapers.

### 💳 Wallet Card Discovery & Bank Identification
• **Universal Wallet Log Parser**: Ported the proven `WalletScanParser` from AirCard macOS. Captures cards from `Dashboard loading (...): for SOO+`, `passIDs[InSession]`, `passIDs[global]`, and modern JSON NFC activations (`"identifier": "HEX"`).
• **Automatic Bank & Network Detection**: Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Discover, and JCB via applet AIDs during selection.
• **Card Nicknames (Rename)**: Added a direct **Rename** button (✏️) so you can give your cards friendly names like *"Monobank"*, *"Salary Card"*, or *"Revolut"*, safely persisted in app settings.
• **28-Character Fallback Token Matcher**: Restores dependable card discovery on devices where standard log patterns are redacted.

### ⚡ Ultra-Fast Tunnel Routing (from 10s to 0.02s!)
• **Working Route Caching**: `rust-core` now caches the active RSD connection route (`LAST_WORKING_ROUTE`), eliminating repeated port and interface scanning.
• **RSD-First Priority**: Connects directly via RemoteXPC on port 49152, bypassing slow Lockdown retries and broken pipes on iOS 18+.
• **Eliminated Loopback Policy Drops**: Removed local loopback attempts that caused `policy drop` control channel errors.

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies) — Collections & Mercury Fixes
• **Dual Injection on iOS 18+**: Wallpapers are now injected into both their primary bundle (`com.apple.WallpaperKit.CollectionsPoster` or `com.apple.MercuryPoster`) and the modern iOS 18+ application container (`com.apple.Posters.CollectionsPosterApp` / `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp`).
• **Metadata Synchronization**: Fixed a critical issue where `Wallpaper.plist`'s numeric identifier was randomized out-of-sync with `suggestionMetadata.plist` (`7400.DYNAMIC`), causing wallpapers like Windows 11 to vanish from the Lock Screen gallery.
• **Mercury Wallpaper Support**: Added recognition for `mercury-descriptors` container folders and registered `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp` in `PersistedPosterContainerBundleIdentifiers`.
• **NeoSpring Respring**: Instant springboard reload to apply wallpaper preferences immediately.

### 🧪 Quality & Testing
• All 24 unit tests passing (`TendiesEngineTests`, `WalletScanParserTests`, `CardPhotoCropTests`, `CardPhotoPickerTests`).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

apps.name: Asspp
apps.subtitle: Multi-region App Store manager
apps.localizedDescription: Manage multiple Apple IDs across App Store regions from one app: switch stores instantly, browse and search any region, download official signed IPAs for backup or sideloading, and pull older versions of an app when you need them.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Changes

- Recover downloads when Apple returns an empty HTTP 500 by retrying the version-pinned request through the bag’s update endpoint.
- Update ApplePackage to 2.0.3 with Swift 6.2 compatibility fixes.
- Report Keychain save failures before completing login, and preserve stored data when loading fails.
- Improve empty account layout, editable device identifiers, and account table column widths.
- Remove personal metadata from bundled installation certificates and omit the CA private key.
- Explicitly clear development teams for release builds and check packaged artifacts before publication.

## Installation certificate

The local installation CA was replaced to remove personal metadata. If you use OTA installation, install and trust the new certificate from Settings after updating.

The release contains an unsigned iOS IPA and a macOS ZIP without a personal development team.

apps.name: Camlo
apps.subtitle: 零门槛「滑动解锁变身 + 动态锁屏」壁纸工坊
apps.localizedDescription: 让 iPhone 锁屏活起来：免电脑、免越狱一键直写上滑变身与动态锁屏，支持裸眼 3D 景深、人物遮挡时间、昼夜双生壁纸与 120Hz 实时预览，内置 6 套风光预设与 385+ 款官方云端壁纸（iOS 26+）。

versions.localizedDescription:
## Camlo v1.3.4 (Build 27)

### 彻底修复 iOS 真机锁屏景深破框不触发 (#7, #3)
- **定位并满足 `WallpaperKit` 原生景深白名单校验**：通过逆向 iOS `WallpaperKit.framework` (`supportsDepthEffect`)，确认系统会在切换真机锁屏前强制检查路径中是否包含 `Clownfish` 标记（`ParameterizedCA` 检查 `wallpaper.ca` 所在 `.wallpaper` 路径；`LayeredAnimation` 检查 `floatingAnimationFileNameKey` 指向的 `Floating.ca` 路径）；若不满足，系统即记录 `Depth not supported, collapsing floating view into foreground view` 并将前景层降级压到系统时间之后（导致在 Camlo App 内能遮挡 `09:41`，回到系统真机锁屏却总是时间压人物）。
- **双引擎与历史壁纸自动原地自愈**：现已全面升级 3D `ParameterizedCA`（`7920.Camlo_Clownfish_3D-...wallpaper`）与滑动变身/实况 `LayeredAnimation`（`7400.Clownfish_WWDC_2022-...wallpaper` / `7400.WWDC_2022_Clownfish_Floating-...ca`）；**已保存在金库或外部导入的旧版 `.tendies` 壁纸**在升级至 `v1.3.4` 后会自动原地自愈迁移，无需重新创作。

### 重塑 3D 陀螺仪 (`ParameterizedCA`) 立体视差与消重影 (#3)
- **消除主体背后「双重轮廓重影」**：将背景 (`BG`) 与前景抠图 (`FG`) 的静止超采样倍率对齐为严格 `1:1`（`1.065x`），彻底解决旧版 `1.104x` 与 `1.052x` 尺寸不一致导致静止或晃动时人物头部、剑柄外侧露出一圈较大残影的问题。
- **自动背景遮挡补全 (Occlusion Inpainting)**：在编译 3D 陀螺仪壁纸及金库自愈旧包时，自动对被前景抠图遮住的背景区域执行多尺度金字塔与水平扫线上下文补全，晃动手机错位时背后露出自然衔接的天空/云海/背景纹理，不再出现克隆人影。
- **增加 `sublayerTransform` 3D 透视与立体倾斜**：收窄合理平移幅度并加入 `transform.rotation.x` / `transform.rotation.y` 空间倾角变换，还原接近原生的立体视差体验。
- **云端全部 76 套官方 `.tendies` 同步升级**：涵盖「次元 3D」「海岸海报 3D」「iPhone Duo」「馆藏名画」共 76 套官方云端包已全部重新编译并通过 `CAPackage` 与 SHA-256 校验。

---

### Fix On-Device Lock Screen Clock-Depth (#7, #3)
- **Satisfies `WallpaperKit` `Clownfish` Depth Gate**: Disassembling `WallpaperKit.framework` (`supportsDepthEffect`) confirmed that iOS collapses `FLOATING` behind the system clock (`"Depth not supported, collapsing floating view into foreground view"`) unless `"Clownfish"` appears in the `ParameterizedCA` bundle path or `LayeredAnimation` `Floating.ca` path. Both Camlo compilers (`7920.Camlo_Clownfish_3D-...wallpaper` & `7400.WWDC_2022_Clownfish_Floating-...ca`), all 76 cloud `.tendies` packs, and automatic in-place Vault/import self-healing now conform cleanly.

### Overhaul 3D Gyroscope (`ParameterizedCA`) Spatial Depth & Ghosting Fix (#3)
- **Exact 1:1 Rest Registration (`1.065x`)**: Aligns `Camlo_BG_Overscan` and `Camlo_FG_Overscan` scale identically so subjects register pixel-for-pixel at neutral rest.
- **Exterior-Inward Background Occlusion Inpainting**: Automatically inpaints the occluded region behind `cutout_lock.png` / `cutout_unlock.png` in background JPEGs so tilting reveals continuous background scenery instead of a duplicated ghost silhouette.
- **True 3D Perspective Tilt**: Adds `sublayerTransform` perspective projection (`m34 = -0.0010`), matched `zPosition="0"` parallax planes, and subtle `transform.rotation.x/y` angular tilt alongside tight balanced translation.

> ⚠️ **iOS Compatibility Reminder**: On-device Computer-Free Direct Write supports **iOS / iPadOS 26.0 – 27.3 beta 1** (Apple patched `worse_query` in `27.3 beta 2`). Creation, 120Hz preview, and `.tendies` export continue to work on all versions.

apps.name: CiliCili
apps.subtitle: SwiftUI 第三方 B 站客户端
apps.localizedDescription: 使用 SwiftUI 编写的第三方 B 站客户端实验项目：首页推荐、搜索、UP 主空间、动态（图文/视频/转发）、视频详情与 HLS 播放、弹幕（开关、样式、关键词过滤）、评论与私信，并支持二维码与网页登录（登录态保存在本机 Keychain）。

versions.localizedDescription:
## v1.1.7 更新内容

### ✨ 新增功能
- **原生专栏阅读页**：动态页与搜索结果中的专栏（支持 `cv` 专栏与 `opus` 图文动态）支持原生打开，不再跳转外部网页。
  - 动态中的专栏卡片点击整卡直接进入专栏详情页，无需先经由动态详情页中转。
  - 支持封面、标题、分类/字数/发布时间、富文本排版（标题、粗斜体、删除线、引用、列表、代码块）、正文图片全屏缩放查看。
  - 右上角提供独立的作者头像液态玻璃按钮（点击跳转 UP 主主页）；底部提供与动态详情页一致的**点赞、评论（「点击发送电波」发评及楼中楼回复）、分享**交互栏。
- **视频三分手势控制**（可在「我的 → 播放设置 → 播放体验」中开启）：
  - **左侧 1/3**：上下滑调节屏幕亮度。
  - **中间 1/3**：横屏视频在竖屏下上滑转至横屏全屏、横屏下下滑退回竖屏；竖屏视频上滑进入竖屏全屏、全屏下下滑退出全屏。
  - **右侧 1/3**：上下滑调节音量。

### 🐛 修复与优化
- **应用内画中画（小窗）稳定性与体验优化**：
  - 修复退出视频页后无法自动进入应用内画中画小窗的问题。
  - 修复小窗播放期间点击进入新视频时旧小窗卡住无法播放的问题，并优化旧小窗退出与新视频起播的切换速度。
  - 修复在应用内画中画中点击暂停后仍自动恢复播放的问题。
  - 修复未开启后台播放时，画中画播放期间锁屏未自动暂停的问题（普通返回桌面/切换 App 仍保持小窗播放）。
- **构建与发布规范**：
  - 统一未签名 Release IPA 的默认 Bundle ID 为 `com.rayc.cilicili`。

### 📦 未签名 IPA 信息

- **版本**：`1.1.7 (230)`
- **SHA-256**：`8ca178884b074d84ed5a8e2e584e58d46942c25049111502e6d867d1d8ba3da6`

apps.name: Erosion-CN
apps.subtitle: 系统配置与 MobileGestalt 工具箱
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 worse_query 的简体中文 iOS/iPadOS 系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱，支持写入前差异预览、备份校验、写后读回与自动回滚，并支持一键恢复原厂参数。iOS/iPadOS 27 完整支持，26.x 部分支持。

versions.localizedDescription:
## Erosion-CN v1.0.6 (Build 31)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**：`iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**：Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **General Splash Ad Blocker Whitelist & Manual Manager (`AdWhitelistStore` / `AdWhitelistManagerSheet`) / 去广告应用与路径通用白名单及手动管理面板** *(Thanks to [@appleoner](https://github.com/appleoner) for suggesting [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) / 感谢 [@appleoner](https://github.com/appleoner) 在 [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) 提出建议)*
   - **Dedicated Whitelist Manager (`白名单`)**：Added top-bar & Overview card entry points supporting **manual `Bundle ID` / `AppGroup ID` entry**, **quick-picking from installed third-party containers**, **manual container subpath entry**, and one-tap deletion of rules.
   - **Per-App, Per-Path & File Browser Controls**：Whitelist an entire app + its matching `group.<bundleID>` AppGroups from the container `⋯` menu, exempt a specific folder/config via the row **Ignore (`加白`)** button, or long-press any file/folder in **File Browser** → **Add to Ad Whitelist**.
   - **Auto-Skip & Auto-Restore**：Whitelisted apps and paths automatically skip global **Lock All** (`一键全锁`) and immediately restore `0755`/`0644` writable permissions (cleaning `.erosion_adlock`) when added. Includes a removable default crash-guard entry for **SMZDM (`什么值得买` · `com.smzdm.client.ios`)**.

2. **Built-In Taobao Splash Boot Paths / 内置手机淘宝开屏启动图与配置路径识别** *(Thanks to [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) for sharing in [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) / 感谢 [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) 在 [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) 实测反馈)*
   - Added `Documents/TBDocuments/bootImagebiz` and `Documents/TBDocuments/bootImageDoc` for **Taobao (`com.taobao.taobao4iphone`)**, enabling automatic detection and one-tap anti-recreate `0555`/`0444` locking alongside `TanxAd`, `TanxSDK`, and `SplashAd`.

3. **Native Battery Cycle & Manufacture Date Guard on iPhone 15+ & Modern iPads / iPhone 15 系列及以上电池循环原生支持提示** *(Thanks to [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) for reporting [#55](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/55) / 感谢 [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) 在 [#55](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/55) 反馈)*
   - Automatically detects models that natively show Battery Cycle Count and Manufacture Date in iOS/iPadOS 17.4+ Settings (iPhone 15 series+ and M2/M4+ iPads), locking `[Beta] Show Battery Cycle Count & Manufacture Date on Legacy Devices` when disabled or advising users to turn it off if previously enabled.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

---

apps.name: iPadn
apps.subtitle: 在 iPhone 和 iPad 上管理已购 App
apps.localizedDescription: 在 iPhone 和 iPad 上搜索、下载并安装你已拥有的 App，支持历史版本、已下架应用、多地区比价、已购项目与一键安装。

versions.localizedDescription:
## iPadn 2.3.2

**目录 / Contents**：[简体中文](#-核心修复与优化) · [TestFlight 说明与免责](#-testflight-实验性说明与免责声明) · [English](#english) · [TestFlight Notice](#testflight-experimental-notice--disclaimer)

本次为 **v2.3.2** 修复与体验优化版：全面补全**「已购项目」历史与已下架应用**并大幅提升同步速度，解决切换账号后已购应用图标卡在灰色占位的问题，修复 **TestFlight** 登录误报「暂不支持多个受信任号码」与设备身份缓存失效，并修正深色模式下设置页「可更新」标签看不清的对比度问题。安装包均未签名，请使用自用签名工具签名后安装。

### 🔧 核心修复与优化

- **完整同步「已购项目」历史记录与已下架应用**
  - 在原有 DMAP 活跃目录同步的基础上，接入 Apple 完整购买历史接口（`/commerce/account/purchases`，自动处理 pod/cookie 握手、401/403 会话静默刷新与多语言购买日期解析），并与 DMAP 结果智能合并，找回大量历史与已下架应用（含俄区等地区已下架应用）。
  - 首次全量历史同步改用 **6 路并发** 拉取（并在列表顶部实时显示 `已完成/总年份` 进度），大幅缩短多年账号等待时间；同步完成后自动记录进度，日常刷新仅增量扫描当年记录，几秒即可完成；右上角菜单亦支持随时手动触发「同步完整购买历史」。
- **修复切换账号后已购列表图标一直加载不出来**
  - 修复切换 Apple 账号后，后台防抖更新商店地区时误中止 `loadOwnedArtwork()` 拉取任务的竞态问题；改为按账号自身地区与 `地区|AppID` 维度去重、单批拉取量由 20 提升至 50，切号进入「已购」页可稳定补齐全部上架应用图标，并保留已有缓存不闪烁。
- **修复 TestFlight 登录误报「暂时无法完成验证」与设备槽失效**
  - 修复过期本地 `iphone` 设备槽缓存触发 `rinfo=67437824` 导致 `no usable iphone identity` 无法继续验证的问题：检测到异常后自动清空过期设备槽并重新向 Apple 申请，仍异常时回退使用新配设备尝试 GSA 登录。
  - 修复前端错误分类将 `"no usable iphone identity"` 中的 `"iphone"` 误匹配为 `"phone"` 而提示「暂不支持选择多个受信任号码」的 Bug。
- **修复深色模式下「可更新」标签白底白字看不清**
  - 修正「账号 › 设置」行右侧更新提示胶囊在深色模式下的前景色（由硬编码白色改为自适应 `UX.onAccent` 配合 `UX.tint`），浅色与深色模式下文字对比度均清晰可辨。

---

### 📢 官方频道与反馈说明

- **官方 Telegram 频道**：👉 [**https://t.me/ipadn_official**](https://t.me/ipadn_official)
- **GitHub Issues 仅保留只读归档**：新版安装包与源码优先在官方 Telegram 频道发布；使用问题、排障与 Bug 反馈请直接前往频道**对应版本贴文评论区**提交。

### ⚠️ TestFlight 实验性说明与免责声明

### English

**v2.3.2** is a targeted fix and quality-of-life update: it recovers missing historical & delisted apps in **Purchased** with fast concurrent syncing, fixes purchased app icons getting stuck on gray placeholders after switching accounts, resolves a false **TestFlight** "multiple trusted phone numbers" verification error & stale device slot deadlock, and fixes Dark Mode contrast on the Settings update badge. Both packages are unsigned—sign with your own tool before installing.

#### Fixes & Improvements Since v2.3.1

- **Complete Purchase History & Delisted App Recovery**
  - Complements the fast DMAP active-catalog sync with Apple's full `/commerce/account/purchases` purchase history endpoint (supporting pod/cookie handshakes, automatic 401/403 silent session refresh, and multi-locale purchase dates), merging both sources so older and delisted apps appear reliably alongside active ones.
  - Uses **6 concurrent workers** with inline year-by-year progress for the initial full-history backfill, then persists sync state so subsequent refreshes only scan the current year incrementally in a few seconds; a **Sync Full Purchase History** option is also available in the top-right menu.
- **Fixed Purchased List Icons Staying Gray After Account Switch**
  - Eliminated a race condition where the debounced storefront-country sync aborted `loadOwnedArtwork()` right after switching accounts, scoped deduplication per storefront (`country|appId`), raised batch size from 20 to 50, and preserved cached icon URLs across history merges.
- **Fixed TestFlight False "Multiple Trusted Phone Numbers" Error & Device Provisioning**
  - Automatically wipes and re-provisions stale cached `iphone` device slots returning `rinfo=67437824` (with fallback to the freshly provisioned device instead of deadlocking locally).
  - Tightened multi-phone error classification so `"no usable iphone identity"` no longer falsely matches `"phone"`.
- **Fixed Dark Mode Update Badge Contrast**
  - Updated the Settings row update pill on the Account tab from hardcoded white text to `UX.onAccent` on `UX.tint`, keeping it crisp and readable in both Light and Dark Mode.

Testing with a secondary Apple Account first is recommended, and never share pairing files, tokens, or unencrypted backups (see [README_EN — TestFlight Experimental](README_EN.md#testflight-experimental)).

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.subtitle: Battery, charging and thermal instrument for iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: A battery, charging and thermal instrument for iPhone, built on Apple's private power-management APIs. It shows what the charger is delivering, how much of it reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and what the phone's temperature sensors are doing while it happens.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 改进

- **温度可以显示为华氏度。** 设置 → 单位 里可选"自动 / °C / °F"。"自动"跟随系统地区，以及"设置 › 通用 › 语言与地区"里的"温度"选项，所以地区使用华氏度的用户升级后会直接看到 °F。App 各页、图表、热力图、悬浮读数、实时活动和小组件都按所选单位显示；原始数据仍显示传感器给出的 °C。(#25)
- **充电预估。** 充电时，功率页会显示充到 80% 和充到 100% 还要多久，以及大约几点。时间根据电量实际上升的速度推算，不依赖电池能量设置；要等电量变化两次才会出现，通常需要几分钟。80% 以后按典型充电曲线估算，只是近似值。(#27)
- **显示版本号。** 设置 → 关于 里显示当前版本，原始数据导出的第一行也带上了版本号。(#27)
- **iPad 布局。** iPad 横屏和 13 英寸竖屏时，各页分成两栏；窄屏时仍是一栏。历史记录里单次充电的详情页在 iPad 上不再横向铺满。(#22)
- **iPad 热力图。** 在 iPad 上，发热页画的是 iPad 的轮廓，各区域按 iPad Pro 11 英寸的内部布局放置：主板在中间，两侧是电芯，充电芯片在 USB-C 接口旁。设备页和设置里的图标也换成了 iPad。(#13, #22)

## 修复

- 发热：CPU 簇（`pACC`、`eACC`）和图像处理器（`ISP`）等传感器以前被归入"其他传感器"，现在算作 SoC，SoC 区域的温度也会把它们算进去。iPhone 11 上 `FrontCameraDie`、`BCMLBSkin` 这类名字连写的传感器以前会被分错区（比如前摄像头被当成机身），现在会先拆词再归类。(#13, #14)
- 适配器页里"单次采样"那段说明以前在中文界面下一直显示英文，现在已有中文。

## 注意

- iPad 相关的改动只在模拟器里验证过，我手上没有 iPad。如果在 iPad 上看到问题，请从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
- iPad 上"来自充电器"的功率偏低（#13）这次还没有修：要确认其余的输入由哪个传感器测量，需要一份**充电时**导出的原始数据。有 iPad 的话，请在充电时从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出，贴到 #13。
- 充电预估无法知道是否开启了充电上限或优化电池充电。如果开着，电池会在上限前停下，"充到 100%"的时间就不准。

---

## Improvements

- **Temperatures can be shown in Fahrenheit.** Settings → Units offers Automatic, °C or °F. Automatic follows your region and the Temperature option under Settings › General › Language & Region, so if your region uses Fahrenheit you will see °F straight after updating. Every page, the charts, the heat map, the floating meter, the Live Activity and the widget follow the setting; Raw data still shows the sensors' own °C. (#25)
- **Charge forecast.** While charging, the Power page shows how long until 80% and until 100%, and roughly when. It is worked out from how fast the battery level is actually rising, so it does not depend on the battery energy setting; it appears once the level has moved twice, usually within a few minutes. Past 80% it follows a typical charging curve and is approximate. (#27)
- **Version number.** Settings → About shows the installed version, and the first line of the Raw data dump includes it. (#27)
- **iPad layout.** On an iPad in landscape, and a 13-inch in portrait, every page uses two columns; narrower windows keep one. A session's detail page in History no longer stretches edge to edge on an iPad. (#22)
- **iPad heat map.** On an iPad the Thermal page draws an iPad, with the zones placed as in an iPad Pro 11-inch: logic board down the middle, a battery cell either side, the charge IC by the USB-C port. The Devices page and Settings use iPad icons too. (#13, #22)

## Fixes

- Thermal: the CPU-cluster (`pACC`, `eACC`) and image-processor (`ISP`) sensors used to land under "Other sensors"; they now count as the SoC, and the SoC zone's temperature includes them. On an iPhone 11, run-together sensor names such as `FrontCameraDie` and `BCMLBSkin` were filed in the wrong zone (the front camera as chassis); names are now split into words before they are matched. (#13, #14)
- Adapter: the one-sample note always showed in English in the Chinese interface; it is now translated.

## Notes

- The iPad changes were checked in the simulator only — I do not have an iPad. If something looks wrong on yours, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
- The low "from charger" reading on an iPad (#13) is not fixed yet: finding which sensor carries the rest of the input needs a Raw data dump taken **while charging**. If you have an iPad, please copy one from Settings → Raw data while it charges and post it on #13.
- The charge forecast cannot tell whether a charge limit or Optimized Battery Charging is on. If one is, the battery stops short and the time to 100% will be wrong.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0

apps.name: Opaline
apps.subtitle: YouTube client for iOS 12+
apps.localizedDescription: A lightweight, privacy-focused YouTube client for iOS, built with UIKit. SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike, up to 1080p playback, background audio, Picture-in-Picture, subtitles and offline downloads — no ads, no tracking, no dependencies.

versions.localizedDescription:
**New**

- Hold anywhere on the video to seek ([#116](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/116)). Press and hold on the picture, then drag sideways. The seek bar follows your finger and the video jumps where you let go, so you no longer have to hit the thin bar at the bottom. The taps you already know still work: the sides seek, the middle pauses.
- Search inside a channel ([#117](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/117)). Channel pages have a magnifier now, and whatever you type there searches that channel only. YouTube serves no filters for this kind of search, so there are none in the app either.
- Get a downloaded video out of the app ([#115](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/115)). The menu on a downloaded video has a new "Save to Files" row that hands the file to the usual iOS share sheet, so it can go to Files, Photos, AirDrop or another app. It is named after the video, and only the video leaves: subtitles, comments and the saved page stay where they were.
- Clear the whole search history at once ([#121](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/121)). The last row under Recent searches wipes the list, and it asks first.

**Fixes**

- The mini player no longer sits on top of the tab bar ([#118](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/118)). Tapping a tab behind the collapsed player switches to that tab instead of reopening the video.
- Stereo no longer gets spatialized on AirPods ([#119](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/119)). Ordinary two-channel sound was being turned into a fake surround field that moved when you turned your head. Video that really is multichannel still spatializes.
- The "..." menu stops closing on its own ([#128](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/128)). It was reacting to the device being tilted or put down, which made it look random when you held the phone in your hand.

**Also**

- If your device is older than Opaline supports, the README now points at [a downport for iOS 9](https://github.com/Joeviocoe/Opaline) by another developer, which runs on the iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad mini and iPhone 4S ([#125](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/125)).

versions.localizedDescription:
> **Requires:** iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2, or iOS 27.0 up to 27.3 beta 1. **Not supported:** iOS 27.3 beta 2 and later, where Apple patched worse_query. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 27.3 beta 1 (confirmed by a user) and 26.7.1; see [Tested devices](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#tested-devices).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.19

A small fix release, plus optional App Store icons.

## New

- **Settings → App Store Icons** (off by default): other apps' icons can't be read with worse_query, so WQ Files can fetch them from Apple's public App Store lookup instead. This sends the bundle ids of your installed apps and your region to Apple. Sideloaded apps and apps that were removed from the App Store keep the placeholder. Icons are stored in WQ Files (about 7 KB each, not backed up); turning the setting off deletes them.

## Fixed

- **Apps with one-word bundle ids** like Pinterest (`pinterest`) showed "container identity unavailable" and 0 KB, and couldn't be opened, backed up or cleared. They work now.
- **App icons:** other apps' icons can't be read with worse_query, so they show a placeholder. Third-party apps now all get the neutral one, instead of misleading guesses like the Books icon for Facebook or the Music icon for TikTok. Apple services that iOS only gives a placeholder for no longer show iOS's grey grid in dark mode.
- **Apps list on iOS 27:** the header above the list (number of apps and their size) showed as an empty band, leaving a large gap. It shows its text again, with less space above it.
- **iOS 27 beta 5 / public beta 3** ([#70](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/70)): after swiping back from App Backups, the first row on the Backups tab stopped responding. It keeps working now. The blurred band under the bar can still look too tall on that beta; that's an iOS bug. Release versions of iOS aren't affected.

## Credit

New design: GpGp700. Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Resumable scans: hhh2210. Custom inspectors idea: deltaII. Translations: iosrxwy and FrogTool (Simplified Chinese), kinboy56 (Japanese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian), romlayvn-93 (Vietnamese), buraakkcayir (Turkish review). Thanks to control0forver for testing four debug builds, and to everyone who sent screenshots and Logs. GPL-3.0-or-later.

这个版本的主题是「找得到、看得懂、拿得走」：

- **全局文件搜索**：跨 App 搜索用户文件，结果边扫边出；支持文件名 / 相对路径 / App 名、类型与最小大小筛选、路径 / 大小 / 最新排序。结果可原地预览或打开所在目录，扫描中可取消。
- **空间变化**：按「较上次 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天」比较，按增长排序并显示合计占用与净变化；新增全部 App 合计趋势图，单 App 详情保留当前大小、较上次、近 7 天与扫描历史。
- **文件审计与导出**：大文件 / 重复文件按 App 分组，重复项经 SHA-256 确认；清理时每个 App 至少保留一份，删除进入空间透镜回收站。导出中心可分享或存储到「文件」，目标写入完成才记成功，取消 / 失败会清理临时目录。
- **安全与一致性**：跨 App 的相同文件不再被当成可互相替代；重复清理不能选中某个 App 的最后一份；上次中断的导出在重开后显示「已中断」；清理 14 个无用本地化 key，中英文 813 个 key 对齐。
- **界面**：修复空间变化页底部被悬浮 Tab Bar 遮挡；补充全局搜索、空间趋势、导出选择面板的中英文文案。

验证：23 个本地测试程序、9 条模拟器 UI 流程、Debug 模拟器与 Release arm64 构建、`xcodebuild analyze` 全部通过，编译警告 0 条。

已知边界：本轮 IPA 未签名，未在真机安装；超大 App 的冷扫描耗时、App Group 签名、分享 / 存储到「文件」以及强制中断场景仍需真机验收。空间趋势样本不足时显示「—」，这是预期行为。

**遇到问题或有建议，欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/hseons/WQManager/issues) 提出**。请尽量附上系统版本、App 名称、复现步骤和截图；崩溃日志可配合附件中的 dSYM 定位。

附件为**未签名 IPA**、SHA-256 和 dSYM，请按项目说明保留 App Group 权限重新签名后安装。

apps.name: WrapPin
apps.subtitle: 本机虚拟定位与步行路线测试工具
apps.localizedDescription: 在一张地图上选择、测试并移动 iPhone 向系统报告的位置：支持固定位置、步行与驾车路线模拟、收藏与历史记录，结束后可恢复真实位置。它通过本机配对与设备隧道建立开发者定位会话（默认使用 LocalDevVPN）。这是 Roam Control 的非官方中文分支，仅供在你自己拥有并控制的设备上做开发与测试。

versions.localizedDescription:
优化自定义路线的地点搜索：

- 国内输入和点击“搜索”统一使用联想候选；点击“搜索”收起键盘，保留原来的候选列表，不再换成另一批结果。
- 点击具体地点直接加入路线并返回，无需再次选择。
- 联想结果统一显示添加图标，防止重复点击添加。

候选数量由地图服务决定，最多显示六条。坐标输入、海外搜索和首页搜索保留原有方式。

**安装**

Standard 标准版适合 SideStore 与外部设备隧道；Tunnel 隧道版需要匹配的 Packet Tunnel 签名权限。两版均为 iOS/iPadOS 18.0+ 未签名 IPA，沿用原签名身份覆盖安装同一版本类型即可。

路线搜索、候选保留、取消、恢复与定位连续性回归及双版 Release 包体校验通过；真实地图服务返回结果和签名安装仍需手机验收。

versions.localizedDescription:
## 更新日志

### 新增
- 桌面端支持从账号最近发布的动态、评论中识别手机型号和系统信息，自动用于请求设备配置；无可用记录时使用 iPhone 18 Pro Max 兼容模板。
- 设备设置页展示自动识别的机型及来源。自动配置保留手动指纹和已保存的数盟设备 ID，切换账号时重新识别。
- 搜索分类支持拖动排序，并可收起不常用栏目。
- 无图模式新增详情页图片显示开关。
- 新增浅色界面底色自定义和动态背景图显示开关。
- 话题页新增我的点评卡片。
- 设置页新增“液态玻璃”总开关，默认关闭，可统一控制首页和话题导航的液态玻璃效果。

### 优化
- 移动首页滚动时可自动收起搜索栏和底部导航；详情页底栏支持随滚动隐藏。
- 优化移动端上传、下载布局，并增加 CDN 上传入口。
- 优化首页与话题的沉浸式导航，适配 Android 和 iOS 安全区，并统一上下导航的玻璃效果。
- 优化设置页窄屏和大字体下的布局。
- 设置中心统一使用一个“设置”标签，切换菜单不再新增标签，返回时打开最近访问的栏目；已有固定和收藏的设置标签自动合并。
- 隐藏桌面设置内容区与侧栏重复的栏目标题，保留说明和功能分组。

### 修复
- 修复私信列表中同一联系人可能重复显示的问题，覆盖缓存恢复、刷新及分页加载场景。
- 修复已安装测试版选择稳定版更新渠道时，错误展示旧稳定版更新日志、发布日期和 Release 链接的问题。
- 修正关于页的版本类型与更新渠道说明，避免测试版安装包被误认为稳定版。
- 修复手机快捷入口图标缺失。
- 修复系统榜首屏内容不足时不继续加载下一页，以及双列瀑布流滚动抽动、短列加载不及时的问题。
- 修复切换应用窗口标签后话题列表意外刷新的问题。
- 修复头条刷新和分页时游标传递异常。
- 修复私信图片预览及输入区高度调节问题。
- 修复详情评论点赞状态的主题色显示，以及话题简介文字与背景对比度不足的问题。
- 修复私信列表已收到新消息、当前聊天窗口却未及时更新的问题，现在会自动同步聊天内容，并在展示后更新已读状态；同步时保留输入草稿和历史消息阅读位置。
